card: Simplifies macOS codesign verification in CI scripts as a followup to PR #34914. It replaces compound environment checks with a dedicated RUN_MACOS_CODESIGN flag and removes a redundant conditional subshell wrapper around the codesign command. The change is minor CI script maintenance with no dependencies and no impact on node operation.
changed_since_previous: The current diff specifically introduces RUN_MACOS_CODESIGN=true in the macOS native environment setup script and drops the explicit subshell conditional error block in the test script.
evidence: PR description links to review feedback on merged PR #34914: 'Followup to #34914. See https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34914#discussion_r4043925876.'
problem: CI relied on testing general environment variables (CI_OS_NAME and GOAL) to trigger codesign verification, and used a verbose subshell block to report failure instead of following typical CI script patterns.

risk.why: Touches only CI test runner shell scripts; a syntax error would break the macOS native CI task.

summary: Replaces compound environment checks for running macOS codesign verification in CI with a dedicated RUN_MACOS_CODESIGN flag. In addition, it removes a redundant conditional subshell wrapper around the codesign command so any exit failure propagates directly.
